inputs.label: Sega Rally Championship arcade ROM set (MAME 0.289)
inputs.help: Your own MAME 0.289 set srallyc.zip. Leave it zipped.

inputs.label: Billboard ROM set (segabill.zip), only if needed
inputs.help: Add segabill.zip only if your srallyc.zip does not already include the billboard ROM. Leave it zipped.

steps.why: The app searches all storage for the ROM sets. The guide has the user allow this in the headset.

steps.text: Open Port0r: Rally VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for All files access, allow it. The game copies the ROM set in and starts; until then, a setup screen lists any missing files.

notes: Rally VR uses plain v<version> tags in port0r; ^v\d skips the other games and the android-, pc-, linux-, mac- and switch- builds of Sega Rally. Releases before v0.1.0 had a different app id and must be uninstalled first; the guide says game files stay. The optional HD texture pack comes from a YouTube video description and is not modelled. Granting the appop over adb is not yet tested on a Quest.
